findings.description: The proposed ProjectProfile keeps docs and ADRs bundled as a single docs_adr detection class while F004 requires each detected class to map into exactly one unified source_kind, yet also says docs_adr maps to doc/adr. That is not a total one-to-one mapping and can make ADR coverage invisible or ambiguously folded into generic docs.
findings.recommendation: Split docs and adr into separate detection classes, or make each docs_adr detection item carry an explicit source_kind so the exported mapping remains total and deterministic.

findings.description: F001 detects infra/config surfaces and F004 reports infra/config coverage, but F003 only guarantees graph nodes for directories, package/build/config manifests, test dirs, docs, and ADRs. Infra can therefore be detected and covered without being represented in the filesystem/config graph the operator sees.
findings.recommendation: Extend the tier-0 inventory graph acceptance to require detected infra surfaces, such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and CI files, to appear as source_kind=infra nodes in the final build_view_state payload.

findings.description: F003 requires heuristic import edges for common languages, while F004/F005 require Python and JS parser-backed imports to remain covered/high. The merge precedence is not specified, so parser-backed repos could still render duplicate low-confidence heuristic edges and look less certain than the preserved parser result.
findings.recommendation: Pin the graph merge rule: parser-backed tier-2 edges supersede same-source heuristic edges for that language, and heuristic import extraction only fills gaps where parser coverage is unavailable or unresolved.

findings.description: The objective explicitly excludes a UI overhaul, but the proposed features do not include a negative acceptance guard that the new coverage block is surfaced through the existing display path only. That leaves room for scope creep into Plan D while implementing C0.
findings.recommendation: Add a non-goal guard or snapshot assertion that C0 only adds the coverage data/render payload expected by the existing coverage display and does not introduce broader UI restructuring.
